reason: The command-script and stdio protocols accept dynamic JSON payloads by design. Their CLI entry points are untyped; callers that need compile-time engine types must use the language APIs instead.
The native packages do not yet host the authenticated extension relay or install and manage its browser extension. The shared JavaScript CLI exposes the extension attach command.
The native engine adapters can read trace bundles but do not yet instrument navigation, DOM mutations, and network events to write them.
